svg.title: A-302 Central Kitchen & Laundry — Enlarged Plan
svg.text: External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Enlarged from A-100. The kitchen is reduced 30 % on the
client's instruction; the area released carries a staff
WC, an internal bin store and a servery on the route in,
so bins no longer stand out on the patio.
2. Kitchen fit-out: a wet run on the west wall with a deep
bowl sink and undercounter refrigeration, a cooking line
on the north wall under the extract hood, and a
3. Laundry takes one washer-dryer, a utility sink and a
folding counter, as instructed. Linen and housekeeping
stores are next to it off the same hall.
4. The hall in block B is 1.10 m clear and serves the
laundry, the guest bath, the linen store and the guest
bedroom, so none of them is entered through another room.
5. Kitchen extract rises in a fire-rated shaft inside the
riser cupboard off the fire lobby and discharges above
roof level. Suppression over the cooking line; 2 hour
Withdrawn at P22 — superseded by A-100 to A-104. Record only; not for construction, pricing or measurement.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
P22 2026-10-08 A-300 to A-302 withdrawn: enlargements of a building not being built
